name: Riu Palace Paradise Island - Adults Only - AI
description:
Hotel Riu Palace Paradise Island for adults only is located on an impressive white-sand beach on Paradise Island, in the Bahamas. This All-Inclusive 24-hour hotel has the best facilities for you to enjoy an unforgettable stay, such as free WiFi throughout the hotel, an extensive range of cuisine and the exclusive service of RIU Hotels & Resorts.
The 350-plus rooms in this Adults Only hotel on Paradise Island are equipped with a whole host of amenities, such as minibars, beverage dispensers, air conditioning and coffee machines. If you fancy cooling off during your stay, the facilities include two swimming pools, one with a swim-up bar, and a lounger and parasol area with beverage service. You can also enjoy direct access to the reserved beach area and relax in the lounge chairs under the warm Bahamian sun.
At the Hotel Riu Palace Paradise Island you will find various restaurants for you to savour the best dishes created by our chefs. You will also be able to enjoy continental breakfast buffets with show cooking, try Japanese and Fusion specialities or sample the hotel bars’ most delicious snacks and aperitifs, as well as the patisserie and ice-cream parlour ‘Capuchino’. And if you want a truly unforgettable night, we can arrange a romantic al-fresco dinner.
The entertainment programme that you will find in this Adults Only All-Inclusive hotel on Paradise Island is the perfect complement to your holidays, since you can enjoy live shows and music that will leave you astounded. The sportier among you also have the option of hitting the gym or practising beach volleyball, windsurfing, scuba diving or kayaking around the hotel. And if you need to relax, our Renova Spa has a sauna, whirlpool bath, and a long list of beauty treatments for you to try when you like.
Paradise Island is a heavenly destination where you can spend a well-deserved holiday and enjoy its beaches, landscapes and tourist attractions. During your stay you can discover Nassau, the capital of the Bahamas, or experience incredible moments such as swimming with dolphins off Salt Cay island. If you would like more information, browse our Paradise Island tourism guide or learn about the best offers at Hotel Riu Palace Paradise Island. Come and discover this paradise in the Bahamas with RIU Hotels & Resorts!
Important Information
Spring Break Policies: Spring Breakers (either groups or individuals, regardless of age) are not allowed at this property, at any time during the year. RIU Hotels & Resorts, reserves the right to withhold admission to any Spring Breaker. The hotel reserves the right of admission and may request clients to show passport or official ID to prove full identification. Guests can and will be removed from the property at their own expense in case of any disturbance or complaint from other guests or hotel staff. Parties in rooms are not allowed. Spring break groups or unruly behavior is not allowed all year round at any property.

description: This hotel is situated in the downtown area of Nassau. The hotel is situated just a few steps away from the Government House and within easy walking distance of the National Art Gallery of the Bahamas, Arawak Cay and Haynes Oval. Draped in tradition and culture, the hotel enjoys a charming style. The guest rooms are beautifully appointed, showcasing the splendour of the style of the islands. name: Ocean West Boutique Hotel
description: Ocean West is a 10-room boutique hotel and is Nassau's newest luxury hotel and vacation rental superbly situated seventy feet above sea level with breathtaking views of Lake Killarney to the south and the Atlantic Ocean to the north. We are an exclusive resort with remote access only for our guests. This resort is located in the western district of New Providence and we are a 5 minute drive from Lynden Pindling International Airport. Located just minutes away from the Cable Beach strip, which features casino gaming, fine dining and exciting nightlife, Ocean West Hotel was once a private residence and construction of this building began in 1989 and was completed in 1993. Renovations to the residence began in 2014 and completed in 2015 converting it into a boutique hotel. The original architect was Henry Melich who's concept and design for this building were taken from Palladian architecture which was derived and inspired by designs of venetian architect Andrea Palladio, who was born in Italy in 1508 and died in 1580. Hence, the drawings are an evolution of Palladio's original concept.
